newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-ENGLAND VS NZ SELECTION XI SCOREBOARD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLAND VS NZ SELECTION XI SCOREBOARD.

text.p: Final scoreboard in four-day
tour match between England and a New Zealand Selection XI at
Palmerston North on Thursday.
Selection XI first innings 138
England first innings 427-8 dec (A. Stewart 153 ret. hurt,
N. Hussain 139)
Selection XI second innings (overnight 25 for one)
C. Spearman c Atherton b Cork 6
B. Pocock c Hussain b Tufnell 43
A. Parore c Stewart b Silverwood 13
M. Horne c Knight b Tufnell 11
M. Greatbatch run out 10
J. Vaughan c Knight b Silverwood 1
L. Howell c Tufnell b Silverwood 31
P. Wiseman lbw b Tufnell 0
M. Haslam c Stewart b Tufnell 3
D. Morrison st Stewart b Tufnell 30
R. Kennedy not out 16
Extras (nb-5, lb-7) 12
Total (69.1 overs) 176
Bowling Cork 14-1-58-1, Caddick 18-7-24-0 (nb-1), Silverwood
Result: England won by an innings and 113 runs.
